name: Demon Wraith
source:
Gabrielle's day was already bad enough. Her day-off has been cancelled, the city is under siege by a serial killer and the authorities are unable to catch the culprit. However, an earthquake strikes the city and a horde of monsters appears in large numbers. With the defenders outnumbered, the monsters overtake the city, turning it into a living hell. 

Now, Gabrielle must partner up with the mysterious Vincent and other survivors to discover the cause of the city's downfall and survive long enough to bring help. 

But is it already too late?

[Edited from [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/demon-wraith-a-horror-themed-visual-novel#/]Indiegogo[/url]]
translation:
加布里埃尔的一天已经够糟了：休假被取消，城市遭连环杀手围困，当局却抓不到凶手。然而，地震袭击城市，大量怪物出现。守军寡不敌众，怪物占领城市，将它变成活生生的地狱。

现在，加布里埃尔必须与神秘的文森特和其他幸存者合作，找出城市毁灭的原因，并活得足够久，以便寻求援助。

可是，会不会已经太迟了？

[编辑自[url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/demon-wraith-a-horror-themed-visual-novel#/]Indiegogo[/url]]
